newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Stork's Fokker Services opens in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Stork's Fokker Services opens in Singapore.

text.p: Industrial systems and services group Stork NV said its Fokker Services aircraft maintenance unit would open a branch in Singapore on March 1.
Stork said the new Fokker Services Asia Ltd would initially concentrate on maintenance and modification work for the 250 Fokker aircraft which are flown in the Far East.
By January 1998 the new company would offer a full range of maintenance, logistic and technical services, Stork said.
Fokker Services expects to achieve annual sales of 100 million guilders in the Far East within three years.
In January the company opened a subsidiary in Atlanta to service the American market.
Fokker Services is part of the profitable aircraft maintenance and component businesses acquired by Stork following the bankruptcy of Dutch planemaker Fokker NV.
